critical_constraints: FACE: adult woman, apparent age 32, oval face with soft jaw, slightly wide nose bridge, full lower lip, left eyebrow sits 1 mm higher than right, small flat mole on left cheekbone
EYES: dark brown almond eyes, normal size for her face, faint under-eye shadows, no catchlight glare, looking straight into the lens
HAIR: dark brown #2B1D15 straight hair, length just past the shoulders, center part, one side tucked behind the right ear, a few loose flyaway strands
LOOK: warm medium-tan skin #B98463 with visible pores and slight unevenness on forehead and chin, minimal everyday makeup, relaxed at-home look at night
MEDIUM: must read as an unretouched phone capture, never a render or retouched photo
negative_prompt: oversized eyes, doll face, porcelain or waxy skin, beauty filter, airbrushed, glowing skin, model pose, studio lighting, bokeh, film grain, glasses, earrings, necklace, visible text, logos, watermark, second person, phone visible, mirror, hands near face, 4K, 8K, ultra-detailed, masterpiece, flawless

subject.role: real estate agent at home on a Saturday night, off duty
subject.expression: calm, friendly, about to speak, slight closed-mouth smile 3/10
subject.pose: sitting on a sofa, torso turned 15 degrees to camera, shoulders relaxed, framed chest-up

wardrobe.top: plain oatmeal #CDBFA9 crew-neck knit sweater, slightly loose fit, soft wool texture, no logos or prints

scene.location: Mexican middle-class living room at night: grey fabric sofa, beige wall, a floor lamp out of focus behind her right shoulder, a small plant

lighting.key: warm table lamp 2700K from camera left, soft falloff
lighting.fill: weak cool spill from a TV off-frame right, 5600K, very low
lighting.overall: dim but clean exposure, natural contrast

camera.pipeline: iPhone front camera selfie, 26 mm equivalent, arm's length, eye level, slight handheld tilt of 2 degrees
camera.focus: face sharp, background naturally soft from the phone, no artificial blur

color: natural phone processing, no grading look, true skin tones
